adjudicator: coding agent (eval-category wave lane N7/N8), not an independent human reviewer
status: agent-adjudicated; pending independent human relevance review. The frozen corpus files are unchanged.
why: Wave amendment 4 requires N8's disputed negatives to be adjudicated before any N8 number counts. The corpus README names three negative probes whose sources hold related but non-answering evidence and warns that an unavailable answer does not make related memory irrelevant.

questions.answerable: Does accessible public evidence in the family answer the probe? If not, the empty answer gold (required_span_ids: []) stands.
questions.permissible_association: If memory is volunteered on this turn without being asked, which pages would a reasonable reviewer count as useful related memory rather than a false alarm? Pages listed here are excluded from the adjudicated false-alarm count; any other delivered page on the turn still counts.

scoring_rule: N8 reports two false-alarm rates on associative negatives: strict (frozen labels: any delivered page on a negative turn is a false alarm) and adjudicated (a delivered page listed in permissible_pages is not a false alarm). Neither rate deletes or relabels a probe. Withdrawn and private pages are never permissible.

not_permissible.reason: describes the drying-rack change only; nothing about ink
other-party distractor about rainwater on flyers
